summary: A gravitational-wave synthesizer in which each note is a black-hole merger, with a rising chirp and a ringdown, heard through a tunable detector and a long reverb. The on-device interface is in Italian.
features: Up to four events at once; catalogue of real detections
Six engines: modal, FM, supersaw, wavefolder, string and formant
Interferometer, detector noise, 'radio' tuning, reverb with shimmer
'Deja vu' random loop and RUN mode for self-arriving events
48 presets; USB and TRS MIDI with CCs, MIDI learn and clock in
Bluetooth variant for BLE-MIDI controllers; sample bank shared with GRANA
